preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 500, and the number of roads m is between 0 and the maximum possible roads for n cities.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(y) <= int(n) and int(x) != int(y) and 1 <= int(l) <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y, l in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range, and each road length is between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(str(cst) for s in range(1, int(n)) for t in range(s + 1, int(n) + 1) for cst in [count_roads_on_shortest_paths(s, t, parsed_roads)])
postconditions.description: For every pair of cities s < t, cst is the number of roads that lie on at least one shortest path from s to t. If no path exists, cst is 0.
